name: read_current_and_journal
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys,re,json
from pathlib import Path
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/critical-journal.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','texts/critical-journal.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
print('JOURNAL TEXT',r.stdout)
s=Path('sources/current-core-version.html').read_text()
for token in ['Submission history','Journal reference','Comments:','[v1]']:
 k=s.find(token);print('VERSION',token,s[max(0,k-100):k+1100])
for n in ['openai','leanpool','tauceti','deepmind']:
 s=Path('sources/current-registry-'+n+'.html').read_text()
 print('REGISTRY',n,re.findall(r'"currentOid":"([0-9a-f]{40})"',s))
